latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image Compressor Pro Free.

- Instantly compress JPG, PNG, WEBP, and GIF images up to 200MB with simple prompts—no sliders or manual adjustments.
- Cloud-based processing: automatically handles user authentication, session creation, and image uploads.
- Export compressed images as 1080p MP4 (and other formats); download links provided on completion.
- Supports both single and batch image uploads for faster workflows.
- User-friendly: explains progress, summarizes results, and handles most errors with clear guidance.
- Free plan includes 100 credits for anonymous users; supports basic export and common image/video/audio formats.
